    static void
    bindLowerPreGamePane(javafx.scene.image.ImageView lowerBackground, javafx.scene.image.ImageView banner)
    Binds an image view such that it resizes dynamically with a certain banner behind it such that: - it never shows empty background space - the top banner preserve its ratio - the bottom background resizes and stretches such that is covers 2/3 of the background's height or the difference between the banner height and the total height of the stage
